title: Navigate from API Request Audit to the Dashboards placeholder
affectedSection: Launcher navigation to API Request Audit and Dashboards
steps: Open the launcher and select API Request Audit.
Use the browser Back control to return to the launcher.
View the Under construction message and select Back to Launcher when you want to return.
reason: Document the verified launcher paths to API Request Audit and the Dashboards placeholder, including the available return controls and under-construction state.
